name: Seed Cashima
source:
Starting off as a weak swordsman who never managed to get past level 4, Seed risks the Toushin Tournament as part of an arrangement with his master, Instructor Mizuhara, in hopes of marrying his longtime girlfriend, and Mizuhara's daughter, Hazuki.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Seed_Cashima]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
